source.title: Mid-Ulster Mail, 6 July 1978, p. 16 ("Statutory notice: persons standing validly nominated, District Electoral Area A"); Mid-Ulster Mail, 6 July 1978, p. 1 ("FIRST WOMAN COUNCILLOR"); Belfast Telegraph, 5 July 1978, p. 9 ("Elected the first lady of Magherafelt"); Mid-Ulster Mail, 8 June 1978, p. 34 ("BY-ELECTION TO FILL COUNCIL VACANCY")
source.publisher: Mid-Ulster Mail / Belfast Telegraph (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: Only one nomination (nomination day Monday 3 July 1978), so she was declared elected unopposed; the deputy returning officer's notice is dated 4 July 1978. The poll set for Thursday 27 July 1978 was not needed.

note: By-election of 4 July 1978 for one seat in Magherafelt Area A (Magherafelt District Council), caused by the death of Councillor Philip Bradley (SDLP) of Draperstown; a co-option of McSorley was blocked by DUP councillor Jim Hyndman's objection, so a by-election was called. Returned unopposed: no poll was held.
